purpose: Score how well a doctor's preferred sessions fit current room, nursing, and existing GP capacity. Advisory for human session allocation — not an automated hire or roster publish.
guards: Compatibility score does not approve onboarding or hire
Available options are suggestions pending human confirmation
Nursing and room constraints can zero a window even if a room appears free
Do not promise patient volume or earnings from match results

strategy: Same day, adjacent period if preferred is limited/full and adjacent is available
Nearest available day same period within ±1 weekday
Any available window matching doctor's secondary flexibility if provided

outputs.availableOptions: Preferred windows that are available or limited (with status)
outputs.alternativeRecommendations: Substitute windows when preferred is limited/full
outputs.perSessionBreakdown: Status, free slots, nursing, existing GPs per preferred key
